_note: v6.6: v6.4 (v10.3 + ConvNeXt-Base 336 independent CNN) with the CLIP member replaced by v5.13 (CoOp + CSP, the best single CLIP model on 3-split validation: 62.59% vs v10.3 61.15%); equivalently v6.5 with the CNN member replaced by the 336 px ConvNeXt (aniq_independent_convnext_base_336_1split).
